citation: Tang F, Li J, Qi L, et al. A pan-cancer single-cell panorama of human natural killer cells. *Cell* 2023.
assay: Integrated scRNA-seq atlas (160,011 NK cells, 716 patients, 24 cancer types)
system: Tumour, adjacent and blood NK cells
data: GEO GSE212890; processed atlas at Zenodo 8275845
key_finding: The CD160-positive signature marks a tissue- and tumour-resident NK state and is low in blood NK cells; DGAT1 and DGAT2 are expressed in a restricted subset of NK states and vary by cancer type.

citation: Borcherding N. uTILity: collection of tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte single-cell experiments with TCR sequencing (28 public studies, 13 tissues, >2.6 million cells). Zenodo 2026.
assay: Harmonised collection of public scRNA-seq with paired scTCR-seq (28 studies, 13 tissues, >2.6 M cells)
system: Tumour-infiltrating T cells (and NK cells) across cancers
key_finding: NKG7 is expressed in CD8 T and NK cells and tracks tightly with the cytotoxic programme (PRF1, GZMA/B/H, GNLY, CTSW) across tumour types; TLR2 is mainly myeloid, with low expression in T and NK cells.

citation: Nieto P, Elosua-Bayes M, Trincado JL, et al. A single-cell tumor immune atlas for precision oncology. *Genome Res* 2021.
assay: Integrated 10x Genomics atlas (>500,000 cells, 13 cancer types)
data: Zenodo 4263972 (Seurat and AnnData objects; the full `TICAtlas.rds` is ~24 GB)
key_finding: CD226 (DNAM-1) is expressed by a subset of CD4 T cells enriched in cytotoxic and Th1-like clusters, and the fraction differs by tumour subtype.

citation: Abdelfattah N, Kumar P, Wang C, et al. Single-cell analysis of human glioma and immune cells identifies S100A4 as an immunotherapy target. *Nat Commun* 2022.
system: Glioma/glioblastoma tumour, immune and stromal cells
key_finding: CXCL12 is expressed by a subset of glioma cells that overlaps the hypoxic (CA9 and HIF1A-high) state; this analysis underlies the CXCL12-positive-cell panels in Giordano et al., Nat Commun 2024.

citation: Cillo AR, Kürten CHL, Tabib T, et al. Immune landscape of viral- and carcinogen-driven head and neck cancer. *Immunity* 2020.
system: HNSCC and healthy-donor CD45+ immune cells
key_finding: No scientific finding: this analysis produces a clean annotated object of tumour and healthy-donor immune cells, plus a CD8 T-cell subset, for use as a query or reference elsewhere.

citation: Sade-Feldman M, Yizhak K, Bjorgaard SL, et al. Defining T cell states associated with response to checkpoint immunotherapy in melanoma. *Cell* 2018.
system: Melanoma tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes, pre/post checkpoint blockade
key_finding: No scientific finding: this analysis reproduces the published T-cell states (including exhausted and cytotoxic CD8 clusters) as a reusable annotated object, with a CD8-only subset.
